security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown references, inline code formatting, regex .exec() calls, or local verification text. Confirmed risks remain around API key handling, external provider calls, CDN usage, local command execution, hidden .env access, and broad $HOME searches.

remediation.issue: API keys may be stored in project .env files or pasted into chat.
remediation.suggestion: Use the platform secret store or provider MCP authentication instead of chat-pasted keys. Remove guidance that normalizes pasted API keys.

remediation.issue: The workflow calls external TTS and image-description services with user content and credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step that names each provider, what data is sent, and which credential is used before any outbound request.

remediation.issue: Generated compositions load GSAP from a public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and vendor the runtime dependency or require an integrity-checked local dependency for rendered projects.

remediation.issue: Some helper instructions search broadly under $HOME to locate skill files.
remediation.suggestion: Use a known skill directory, environment variable, or relative path supplied by the host instead of traversing the user home directory.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs npx and node commands as part of capture, build, and validation.
remediation.suggestion: Document the command list up front and require confirmation before running community skill commands in sensitive workspaces.

content.user_title: Create Website Videos from Captured Pages
content.value_statement: Turning a live site into a clear video is difficult when brand assets, pacing, narration, and validation are scattered. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through capture, storyboard, build, and review steps for HyperFrames videos.
actual_capabilities: Captures a user-provided URL with HyperFrames and stores screenshots, assets, fonts, and extracted text.
Builds DESIGN.md from captured colors, typography, components, and WCAG contrast checks.
Creates storyboard and narration scripts with approval gates for message, timing, and format.
Guides TTS, captions, background music, and beat timing choices.
Builds HyperFrames compositions and validates lint, snapshots, asset use, and playback evidence.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames tooling and browser capture support in the execution environment.
External TTS or image description providers need user-provided API keys.
It is not intended for product launches, pull request videos, or captioning existing video files.
Output quality depends on available website assets and completed user approval gates.

use_cases.title: Create a Site Tour
use_cases.description: Turn a landing page into a short narrated tour that explains the message, visual identity, and main call to action.

use_cases.title: Showcase a Portfolio
use_cases.description: Capture a portfolio site and produce a vertical or square social clip using the site assets and tone.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Video Drafts
use_cases.description: Build a storyboard, script, voiceover plan, and validated HyperFrames preview for client review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Website Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a clear URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video to make a 15-second vertical social clip from this URL: <url>. Keep the message simple and use the site assets.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Before Building
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants control over strategy and tone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for this site: <url>. First propose the video message, audience, format, duration, and narrative arc before building.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Narrated Tour
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video to create a 30-second narrated site tour from <url>. Ask me to approve the storyboard and script before voiceover.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for <url>. Build the HyperFrames project, run lint, validate snapshots, check audio timing, and report every verification result.

output_examples.input: A portfolio site needs a 15-second vertical teaser.
output: A concise site summary focused on audience, tone, and message.
A three-beat storyboard with a short script and timing plan.
A validated HyperFrames preview URL with noted checks and limitations.

output_examples.input: A company homepage needs a 30-second narrated showcase.
output: A DESIGN.md file summarizing colors, fonts, components, and contrast decisions.
A narrated storyboard with approved beats, captions, and voice provider choice.
A final handoff summary with lint, snapshot, asset, and playback evidence.

best_practices: Confirm the route before capture so product launches and unrelated video tasks use the correct skill.
Lock message, audience, format, and narrative arc before choosing visuals or generating voiceover.
Keep captured assets visible and verify every beat before sharing the final Studio preview.
anti_patterns: Do not skip verification gates because autonomous mode is enabled.
Do not rebuild all visuals from generic CSS when captured brand assets are available.
Do not ask for API keys unless the selected provider or snapshot workflow requires them.

faq.question: What kind of website is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for general site tours, portfolio showcases, homepage clips, and social videos based on a user-provided URL.

faq.question: Does it render the final MP4 automatically?
faq.answer: No. The default delivery is a HyperFrames Studio preview URL. MP4 rendering happens only when requested.

faq.question: Can it work without paid voice providers?
faq.answer: Yes. Kokoro can run locally for narration drafts. HeyGen and ElevenLabs require user-provided credentials.

faq.question: Does the skill use assets from the website?
faq.answer: Yes. It captures screenshots, logos, illustrations, fonts, and visible text, then uses them to guide the video.

faq.question: What should users provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the URL, desired length, target format, audience, and the main message the video must communicate.

faq.question: What tasks are out of scope?
faq.answer: Product launch videos, pull request videos, topic explainers without a site, and edits to existing videos should use other workflows.
